project_type: Python search engine with VSM (TF-IDF) and BM25F algorithms
build_system: None - direct Python execution with pip for dependencies
build_command: None - Python module system, no compilation needed
verification_instructions: Run pytest on new test files after each feature. For indexer, also run the CLI command to build indexes and verify output files exist.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Binary indexes (parquet files) in e:\ThesisFinder\data\index\binary\ are generated by python -m src.binary.indexer and should NOT be committed to git. The .gitignore should exclude them.
environment_constraints: Python path must be C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe. Dataset authors and categories fields are numpy arrays (object dtype), NOT string representations requiring ast.literal_eval parsing.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found - follow existing code conventions: docstrings in Indonesian, clean separation between indexing and search, parquet for data storage, numpy for performance.
key_patterns: Index building: save as parquet with config.json metadata (see src/vsm/indexer.py). Search classes: load indexes in __init__, provide search methods with optional candidates parameter (see src/vsm/searcher.py). CLI: use argparse with python -m module_path pattern. Tests: unittest.TestCase classes with pytest runner.
directory_structure: src/: vsm/ (TF-IDF indexer and searcher), algorithm/ (bm25f.py), data_gathering/ (dataset tools). data/: completed.parquet (380,879 papers), index/vsm/ (TF-IDF indexes). test/: test_vsm.py. Binary module will be src/binary/ with indexes in data/index/binary/.
